about: Every HTTP route the device serves (src/WebServer.cpp) with its auth. Checked by tools/api/routes.py. 'required' = needs the password when protection is on (docs/user-guide/security.md); open routes say why.

routes.why: Captive-portal probes from phones and laptops: redirect to the setup screen, change nothing
Read-only: the calibration run's readings and proposal; no address or secret; changes nothing
Read-only: the weather sources, the park and N.I.N.A. as the device last polled them; no address or secret; sends nothing
Read-only: the live diagnostics readings (spec 017), like /api/status; no address or secret; {"enabled": false} while diagnostics are off
Read-only: the move log's summaries and one move's profile (/api/diag/moves/{id}, JSON or CSV); readings only, changes nothing
Read-only: sending or paused, and why
Alpaca setup pages redirect to Settings; the Settings page itself asks for the password on save
ASCOM Alpaca management API: the Alpaca spec has no auth

ASCOM Alpaca device API: the Alpaca spec has no auth. The Dome's open and close pass the same weather and park checks as the REST commands, cannot move a roof of unknown position or clear a fault, and its stop is never refused (constitution I-III, VIII)
